tools.clinical_gate: Clinician must approve requiring every component, the interpretation terminology, management wording, timing, and comparison workflow.
Clinician must approve validated input ranges, population, thresholds, risk factors, confirmation requirements, and escalation wording.
Clinician must approve rejecting invalid measurements, the supported population, measurement ranges, labels, and recommendations.
Clinician must approve requiring all components, non-testable adaptations, severity labels, and escalation wording.
Clinician must approve rejecting age zero, all balance and urine thresholds, supported populations, and condition-specific recommendations.
Clinician must approve dating validation, cycle-length behavior, trimester boundaries, ultrasound rules, and milestones.
Clinician must approve selected-scale suitability, completeness rules, BPS/FLACC mappings, thresholds, and management wording.
Clinician must approve mandatory signs and measured weight, age applicability, symptom modifiers, fluid thresholds, and treatment wording.
Clinician must approve mandatory fields, severity/infection/healing rules, tetanus workflow, and care recommendations.
Clinician and pharmacist must approve age/temperature thresholds, danger signs, mandatory measured weight, medicine doses, and safety-net wording.
Emergency clinician must approve the named signs, full age-adjusted vital matrix, pain escalation, time targets, actions, and local escalation workflow.
Pharmacist and clinician must approve every preset, cap, contraindication, age warning, formulation assumption, and citation.
Cardiovascular clinician must replace or validate the simplified formulas; they must not be labelled Framingham or ASCVD without evidence.
Immunization-program owner must supply and approve versioned jurisdiction schedules, effective dates, prior-dose/catch-up logic, contraindications, and freshness ownership.
